name: Sikagard®-680 S Betoncolor
summary: Sikagard®-680 S Betoncolor is a 1-part, solvent-based, decorative methacrylic protective coating for concrete and cementitious surfaces. It protects against aggressive atmospheric influences and promotes a self-cleaning effect on the treated surfaces. It is available in clear and coloured versions. Sikagard®-680 S Betoncolor complies with the requirements of EN 1504-2 as a protective coating.

Suitable for sealing of green concrete in civil engineering works
usage: As a protective and decorative coating for:
The protection and enhancement of concrete cementitious substrates on building and infrastructure elements
Reducing the deterioration of concrete and assisting with controlling the corrosion of any embedded steel reinforcement
Increasing the service life to all types of concrete structures and elements such as buildings, bridges, car parks
Protection against ingress (Principle 1, method 1,3 of EN 1504-9),
Increasing the resistivity (Principle 8, method 8,3 of EN 1504-9)

items.label: Composition
items.text: Solvent-based acrylate resin

items.label: Shelf life
items.text: 36 months from date of production

items.label: Storage conditions
items.text: The product must be stored in original, unopened and undamaged packaging in dry conditions at temperatures between +5 °C and +30 °C. Always refer to packaging.

items.label: Density
items.text:
Clear coating | ~0,9 kg/l (+20 °C)
Coloured coating | ~1,4 kg/l (+20 °C)

items.label: Product declaration
items.text: EN 1504-2: Surface protection product for concrete - Coating

items.label: Flash point
items.text:
Clear coating | ~+25 °C
Coloured coating | ~+30 °C

items.label: Solid content by volume
items.text: Coloured coating | ~45 %

items.label: System structure
items.text:
Clear coating
Product | Number of coats
Sikagard®-680 S Betoncolor | 2
Coloured coating
Product | Number of coats
Sikagard®-680 S Betoncolor | 2 (with or without primer)
Sikagard®-680 S Betoncolor for bright yellow and red colour shades | 3
Sikagard®-702 W hydrophobic impregnation primer | 1–2
Sikagard®-700 S hydrophobic impregnation primer | 1–2
Note:In marine environments or if the concrete surface is exposed to splashes of de-icing salts, use a hydrophobic impregnation primer for improved protection and durability.

items.label: Diffusion resistance to water vapour
items.text:
Dry film thickness | d = 140 µm
Equivalent air layer thickness | SD, H2O = 2,4 m
Diffusion coefficient | µH2O = 1,8 × 104
Requirement for breathability | SD, H2O ≤ 5 m

items.label: Carbonation resistance
items.text:
Dry film thickness | d = 130 µm
Equivalent air layer thickness | SD, CO2 = 429 m
Diffusion coefficient CO2 | µCO2 = 3,3 × 106
Requirement for carbonation resistance | SD, CO2 ≥ 50 m

items.label: Layer thickness
items.text: Minimum dry film thickness (DFT) to achieve full durability characteristics (CO2 diffusion, adhesion after thermal cycling, etc.) = 101 μm. Maximum DFT to comply with H2O equivalent air thickness of 5 m = 290 μm.

items.label: Ambient air temperature
items.text: +5 °C min. / +35 °C max.

items.label: Dew point
items.text: Substrate and ambient temperature must be at least 3 °C above dew point.

items.label: Substrate temperature
items.text: +5 °C min. / +35 °C max.

items.label: Waiting time to overcoating
items.text:
Waiting time between coats:
Temperature | Time
+10 °C | ~8 hours
+20 °C | ~5 hours
+30 °C | ~3 hours
Note:Refresher coats of Sikagard®-680 S Betoncolor can be applied without priming if the existing coating is fully bonded and is thoroughly cleaned.
Times are approximate and will be affected by film, thickness and changing ambient conditions particularly temperature and relative humidity.

items.label: Curing treatment
items.text: Sikagard®-680 S Betoncolor does not require any special curing but must be protected from rain for at least 1 hour at +20 °C

items.label: Applied product ready for use
items.text:
Full cure: ~5 days (+20 °C)
Dust dry: ~30 minutes (+20 °C).
Times are approximate and will be affected by film, thickness and changing ambient conditions particularly temperature and relative humidity.

items.label: Consumption
items.text:
Product | Per Coat
Sikagard®-680 S Betoncolor Clear coating | ~0,15 kg/m2
Sikagard®-680 S Betoncolor Coloured coating | ~0,20 kg/m2
These figures are theoretical and does not allow for any additional material due to surface porosity, surface profile, variations in level, wastage or any other variations. Apply product to a test area to calculate the exact consumption for the specific substrate conditions and proposed application equipment.

items.label: EQUIPMENT
items.text:
Preparation equipment
Steam cleaning equipment
Abrasive blast cleaning equipment
High-pressure water jetting equipment
Application equipment
Brush
Short pile fleece roller
Airless spray pressure: 150 bar, nozzle diameter: 0,38 to 0,66 mm, angle: 50° to 80°

items.label: APPLICATION
items.text:
Strictly follow installation procedures as defined in method statements, application manuals and working instructions which must always be adjusted to the actual site conditions.
Note:Confirm waiting / overcoating times of any previous coats is achieved before applying subsequent coats. (Refer to waiting / overcoating time in Application Information)
Note:Confirm product application conditions: substrate moisture content, substrate, air and product temperatures, relative humidity and dew point (Refer to Application information).
Primer coat (If required)
Apply the primer evenly over the surface at the required consumption. Refer to the appropriate Product Data Sheet.
Protect primer from rain before applying protective coating.
Protective coating
Note:The product is supplied ready for use. For the coloured version, before application, mix for 2 minutes using a low speed electric single paddle mixer or similar equipment. Mix the liquid and all the coloured pigment until a uniform colour has been achieved.
Note:For the coloured coating, on very absorbent and/or porous substrates, it is recommended to mix in ~50 % of Sikagard®-680 S Betoncolor (Clear version) into the Sikagard®-680 S Betoncolor (Coloured version) for the first coat.
Manual application
Apply the Product evenly over the surface with a brush or short pile fleece roller at the required consumption.
Control the layer thickness during application using a thickness gauge.
To achieve a smooth finish, smooth the surface with a brush.
The coating must be continuous, pore free and to the required surface finish.
Protect the Product from rain for at least 24 hours.
Apply additional coats as required.
Spray application
Spray apply the Product in a continuous operation and at a speed to achieve a consistent thickness and surface finish.
Control the layer thickness during application using a thickness gauge.
The coating must be continuous, pore free and to the required surface finish.
Protect the Product from rain for at least 24 hours.
Apply additional coats as required.
Sealing green concrete
Apply the Product evenly over the surface with a brush, short pile fleece roller or air less spray at the required consumption.
The coating must be continuous and pore free.
Protect the Product from rain for at least 24 hours.
Apply additional coats as required.

items.label: CLEANING OF EQUIPMENT
items.text: Clean all tools and application equipment with Sika Thinner C immediately after use. Hardened material can only be removed mechanically.
